airport_free_sim_info.title_hi: यूएई इमिग्रेशन काउंटर पर फ्री टूरिस्ट सिम
airport_free_sim_info.details_en: All adult tourists arriving at Dubai International Airport (DXB) and Abu Dhabi (AUH) receive a complimentary 'ALSAADA / Tourist SIM' from du or e& directly after passport control. Comes with 1GB free data valid for 24 hours. Can be recharged with additional data through the operator app.
airport_free_sim_info.details_ml: ദുബായ്, അബുദാബി വിമാനത്താവളങ്ങളിൽ എത്തുന്ന സന്ദർശകർക്ക് പാസ്‌പോർട്ട് കൺട്രോളിന് ശേഷം 1GB സൗജന്യ ഡാറ്റയുള്ള സിം ലഭിക്കാറുണ്ട്.
airport_free_sim_info.details_hi: दुबई और अबू धाबी एयरपोर्ट पर इमिग्रेशन के तुरंत बाद 1GB फ्री डेटा वाला टूरिस्ट सिम मिलता है जिसे बाद में रिचार्ज किया जा सकता है।

buying_tips: Always buy your SIM at official operator counters (e& or du) inside the airport arrivals hall - never buy from unauthorized street hawkers.
Have your physical passport and valid UAE entry stamp/visa ready; biometric identification and photo will be taken at the counter.
WhatsApp calling in UAE requires VoIP tools or official apps like BOTIM / GoChat. Traditional WhatsApp audio/video calls are restricted by UAE telecommunication regulations.
Once you receive your official Emirates ID (for workers), convert your tourist SIM to a resident plan to avoid line disconnection.
